_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Barrett H. Clark (1890-1953): French plays for the American stage (Samuel French, 1915-18): Rostand's The Romancers, Rolland's The Fourteenth of July and Danton, Pailleron, Bouchor and Tristan Bernard. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 25); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Rolland's The People's Theater, Sardou's Patrie, Brieux's Artists' Families, Hervieu's The Labyrinth (with Lander MacClintock), Four Plays of the Free Theater and Three Modern Plays from the French (two of its three plays are his).
